entries.55a10630304fc444: It manufactures and sells products made by powder injection molding (PIM), in which metal or ceramic powder is kneaded with a binder, injection-molded, and then debound and sintered to obtain a molded body. This technology enables mass production of complex shapes from hard-to-machine cemented carbide and cemented ceramics, and is applied to automotive turbo parts, ceramic heat-dissipation parts and others. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥263 million.

entries.83c4c9a2d145ac6a: The group consists of the company and three consolidated subsidiaries: atect Engineering Co., Ltd., atect Korea Co., Ltd., and Antaike Keji Co., Ltd. This business manufactures and sells reagents, culture media, and containers such as petri dishes, used to check for microbial contamination in the production of foods, pharmaceuticals, cosmetics and other products. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,928 million, the largest business in the group.
entries.bf8216ad6823dfba: It manufactures and sells spacer tape, a protective material for TAB tape and COF tape used to mount information and electronic device components such as LSIs for driving flat-panel displays and organic EL displays, and LSIs for IC cards. In principle, products are sold directly to electronic component manufacturers. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,165 million.
entries.d2352e51fd9db6db: A manufacturer of culture media and petri dishes used for hygiene testing of foods and pharmaceuticals, and of protective tapes for display LSIs and other products.
